4. "Network Service Discovery (T1046) is used by LockBit affiliates."

	* "Network Service Discovery is also known as T1046."
5. "Use Network Intrusion Prevention (M1031) to detect and prevent remote service scans."

	* "Network Intrusion Prevention is also known as M1031."

Note that I've avoided using pronouns in each statement, as per your request.
